reviewSamples.author: Barry Dotson
reviewSamples.text: Chef Elisa and her team catered a party I attended last night providing unique and delicious bites including flaky spinach turnovers, chicken pops, chicken & waffles, fresh vegetable rolls, meatballs on pita with tzatziki sauce, desserts, ...

reviewSamples.author: Marcelo Valdes
reviewSamples.text: Excellent food , great service, very friendly staff, the mojitos, churrasco, the chicken with the hollandaise sauce the veggies ,appetizers you name it!!,,the best catering experience with a catering service! I highly recommend them for you next event!

reviewSamples.author: betoprads
reviewSamples.text: We had a very big company event last week and our lunch was the most delicious lunch I ever had in many years done by a catering company , the service was amazing, but the food was delicious !!! they are the best !

reviewSamples.author: Troy Bishop, P.E.
reviewSamples.text: The food is incredible, and the staff has their service down to an art!

reviewSamples.author: Alan Locke
reviewSamples.text: Great food and great service for our seminar!

business_notes: Full-service event catering: menu planning, staffing, rentals and bar service, per the business's own Eventective.com listing.
Specializes in weddings, corporate events and private entertaining; handles events from about 50 to 500 guests (Eventective listing).
Offers gluten-free and vegetarian accommodations (Eventective listing).

Business self-description cites over 30 years of experience and a 2013 ARC Broward 'Delish Award' (Fan Favorite dish) win; both corroborated across two independent third-party listings, used as self-reported bio copy.

Eventective listing and a Google Maps photo (Chef Elisa posing with Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson) corroborate a history of catering for celebrities and professional athletes in South Florida; referenced generically in site copy without naming individuals.

Specific dish names used in the site's services copy (spinach turnovers, chicken pops, chicken & waffles, vegetable rolls, meatballs on pita with tzatziki, churrasco, chicken with hollandaise) are taken verbatim from real Google reviews, not invented.

No current published price list found; per-person figures in old directories ($18-$33/event, $28pp hors d'oeuvres) are flagged by search sources as possibly outdated, so the site uses a quote-based pricing pattern instead of displaying a number.
